quote: It's way too bloated and I'm not even sure why I'm doing what I'm doing. This is gonna be a game you'll get bored of eventually and then you'll see the game for what it is. It's a lot for no reason

author: MichaelJson
quote:
Usually when you get older your favorite games are the ones that you played as a kid. This usually has to do with nostalgia. But when I played BOTW in 2017 I experienced one if not my favorite game at the time.
TOTK builds upon that foundation and makes it even better. The story is a lot better and I was amazed at how good the game starts. The abilities this time around are so much better and I'm actually surprised that Nintendo was able to make this mechanics work.
This honestly is the best Zelda game to date and I can't wait to see what they'll have in store next.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

author: MichaelJson
quote: I never really was a fan of the gameplay of the last of us that's not really why I played that game. It was all about the story and the characters but the last of us part 2 feels so far out of place. Some of the scenes in this game feel so forced and uncomfortable. This ain't it!
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: MichaelJson
quote: From the beautiful landscapes, exploration and just the fun combat I can't believe this game turned out as good as it did. A strong game of the year contender if you ask me! **** I'm already ready for a sequel! Let's get it!

author: MichaelJson
quote: This is easily my favorite FF combat system! I love the Gameplay, Music, Voice acting, Characters! I've seen some people complain about the ending but I'm okay with the ending it's kind of mysterious. I'm loving the fact that we don't really know what they're trying to do with the next part. It's something new and fresh to look forward to. We can still enjoy the OG for what it is but now we have this Remake which is so mysterious. It makes us want to know what's going to happen instead of we already knowing what's going to happen and we just want the next part.
